name: ecd-spectra
description: Precise extraction of experimental ECD spectra, measurement conditions, and stereochemical evidence from scientific literature.

interface.shortDescription: Recover ECD spectra, conditions, and stereochemical evidence.
interface.longDescription: An auditable visual workflow that first discovers experimental ECD curve candidates with unambiguous structure and solvent links, pauses for user selection, then separates and validates the chosen traces with concise live progress and diagnostic overlays.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $extract-ecd-spectra to discover eligible experimental ECD curves in the article and supporting information, present their structure, solvent, and source evidence for my selection, then extract confirmed traces with a visual progress monitor and validated reports.
